title: Rollups de conocimiento cero y zk-SNARK
excerpt: Un examen avanzado de sistemas de prueba criptográfica, circuitos aritméticos sobre curvas elípticas, compromisos KZG y agregación SNARK recursiva para el escalado de blockchain.
author: Tariq Mahmood
imageAlt: Futuristic cryptographic network topology representing decentralized zero-knowledge proofs

body.text: El dilema fundamental de las arquitecturas de contabilidad descentralizadas es el cuello de botella de cálculo verificable: si cada nodo de validación en una red global peer-to-peer debe volver a ejecutar cada transacción secuencialmente para verificar la corrección del estado, el rendimiento de la transacción está estrictamente limitado por la velocidad de procesamiento del nodo físico más lento. Los rollups de conocimiento cero (zk-Rollups) resuelven esta restricción mediante sistemas de prueba criptográfica, reemplazando la reejecución distribuida redundante con concisión matemática.

items: KZG Commitments (Used in Scroll, Taiko, Linea): Yield constant-size proofs (typically 48 bytes on BLS12-381 curves) and constant verification time. They require a Structured Reference String (SRS) generated via a cryptographic trusted setup.

FRI Commitments (Used in Starknet / STARKs): Rely strictly on collision-resistant cryptographic hash functions. They require zero trusted setups, are transparent, and provide theoretical post-quantum security at the cost of larger proof sizes (10KB–100KB).

Halo2 & IPA Schemes (Used in Zcash, Scroll): Utilize Inner Product Arguments across elliptic curve cycles, eliminating trusted setup ceremonies without incurring the bandwidth penalties of full STARK proofs.

items: Succinctness Over Re-execution: ZK-SNARKs enable global verifiability where verification cost is $O(1)$ or $O(\log n)$ relative to computation complexity.
Separation of Concerns: Decouple execution (off-chain sequencers) from settlement and finality (Layer 1 smart contract verifiers).
Recursive Aggregation: Modern provers aggregate thousands of sub-proofs into a single master proof, amortizing on-chain verification gas across hundreds of thousands of transactions.
Data Availability Security: Ensure Layer 2 state transitions remain reconstructible through decentralized blob dissemination networks.
